post_1.headline: Before a manuscript even reaches peer review, editors screen it in minutes
post_1.sub: Here's what gets it desk-rejected before anyone reads your results
post_1.cta: All three are avoidable with one review before submission - not after rejection.

post_2.hook: Ever wonder how researchers predict outcomes over time?
post_2.body: It's called survival analysis and it's not just about life and death. It models the time until any event happens: relapse, discharge, device failure. Standard statistics can't handle this property. This is exactly where we specialise.
post_2.footer: One of many advanced methods our team worked with daily.
